amendment_reason: Independent source audit found that vLLM 0.15 predates the compatibility environment switch, ships an incompatible CUDA forward-compat linker entry, lacks the checkpoint-required Transformers model mapping, defaults prefix caching on, and exposed deterministic scorer/staging defects. All were corrected and retested before allocation.
decision: Amortize provider/image/model setup by running a fail-closed sequence on one retained L40S: CUDA compatibility, semantics, paired quality, fixed SLO/performance, then conditional kernel tracing.

causal_hypothesis.primary: Removing vLLM 0.15's unconditional CUDA forward-compat linker override and installing the checkpoint-compatible pinned Transformers revision will make the author's stock runtime initialize on the Nebius CUDA-12.9 driver interface; a semantically valid AWQ representation may then reduce fixed-workload full-VM-plus-disk cost below complete-BF16 H100 without paired quality regression.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: V13 complete BF16 on Nebius H100: c1 87.1156 output tok/s, c8 305.0449 output tok/s, fixed SLO pass, compact quality 0.333 and NLL 7.6455 with absolute gate failure, derived full-VM-plus-disk $3.52799/M output tokens.
causal_hypothesis.runtime_disambiguation_control: V15 custom SGLang AWQ generated nondeterministic gibberish. V16 stock vLLM failed before load with CUDA error 803 and did not test checkpoint semantics.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Compatibility mode passes the sub-minute Torch probe. Conditional on correct stock-vLLM semantics, the 4-bit representation fits L40S and should beat BF16 H100 cost; whether it reaches the $0.88/M analytical anchor and paired quality gate is uncertain.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A compatibility-probe failure stops before model transfer; invalid semantics stops before quality/performance; paired quality failure rejects this public checkpoint for quality-adjusted claims; c8 below 67.565 tok/s rejects even a cost win over BF16 H100.

changed_from_v16.runtime: derive the exact pinned vLLM image only by installing Transformers revision 1618d44, remove both CUDA-compat ld.so entries, run ldconfig, and validate AutoConfig plus a real CUDA tensor before weight transfer
changed_from_v16.allocation_strategy: retain one successfully initialized server for all preregistered conditional arms instead of repeating allocation, image pull, transfer, and model load
changed_from_v16.serving_tuning: use default CUDA graphs, 32,768 context, max 8 sequences, 32,768 batched tokens, 90% GPU memory, and authoritative complete-BF16 tokenizer files
changed_from_v16.repeat_classification: material CUDA compatibility and batched serving-geometry changes; not an unchanged retry

stock_runtime.derived_container_recipe: base digest plus no-deps Transformers source archive at 1618d44b9295361607ec74d7be860ba886aac039; derived image ID measured before use
stock_runtime.cuda_compatibility: delete 00-cuda-compat.conf and cuda-compat.conf then ldconfig before every Python import; VLLM_ENABLE_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY is not used because v0.15 predates it

conditional_sequence: host base-image pull, pinned Transformers derived-image build, glm4_moe_lite AutoConfig preflight, and real Torch CUDA tensor probe
verified checkpoint transfer and remote checksum
two exact deterministic semantic JSON requests
paired development quality capture against V13 complete-BF16 responses including prompt-logprob NLL
one warmup plus frozen c1 4-request and c8 16-request 8192-input/1024-output profiles
bounded post-timing PyTorch kernel trace only if paired quality passes and L40S cost beats complete-BF16 H100

quality_gate.semantic: two normalized messages identical and both contents parse after optional fence removal exactly as {alpha:17,beta:smoke}
quality_gate.absolute_quality: V13 absolute compact-screen failure is carried forward and cannot be converted to a quality-adjusted business claim
quality_gate.claim_limit: paired representation diagnostic only; not general model quality

service_contract.queueing: server Prometheus request-queue-time counter deltas plus request-level TTFT
service_contract.cache_fairness: --no-enable-prefix-caching and zero prefix-cache query/hit counter deltas are required
service_contract.preemption: provider stop is infrastructure failure only

economics.claim_rule: No cost improvement claim without exact fixed geometry, fixed SLO pass, and paired quality pass; no Fireworks/Baseten claim without matched provider evidence.

budget.limitations: public IPv4 and egress excluded; invoice pending

telemetry: one-second GPU utilization, VRAM, power, temperature, and clocks
TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end latency, output throughput, exact token geometry, request failures
vLLM queue-time, TTFT, and TPOT Prometheus counter deltas
startup/load logs and conditional PyTorch CUDA trace
total allocation exposure and derived cost

artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash before deletion; verify instance GET not-found and zero named instances/disks

stop_rules.compatibility: Linker cleanup, pinned Transformers AutoConfig, L40S/sm89 identity, or real Torch CUDA tensor-probe failure stops before transferring the 20GB checkpoint.
stop_rules.delivery: Any source/remote hash, shard-count, or byte mismatch stops before load.
stop_rules.semantics: Any HTTP failure, nondeterminism, non-JSON, or wrong object stops quality/performance and rejects the public checkpoint lineage on this stock runtime/device geometry.
stop_rules.quality: Paired regression or NLL failure rejects quality-adjusted economics and suppresses kernel tracing; fixed performance may still run diagnostically because setup is already sunk.
stop_rules.performance: Exact-geometry, nonzero prefix-cache counters, or SLO failure rejects economics; below 67.565 c8 tok/s rejects a cost win over complete BF16 H100.
stop_rules.repair_in_place: On an untyped infrastructure or harness failure, keep the allocation alive for at most 600 seconds while the coordinator decides whether a materially changed preregistered repair can run immediately; complete scientific negative results close their lineage and tear down without delay.
stop_rules.repeat: Do not repeat any failure unchanged.
stop_rules.cleanup: Always retrieve/hash available evidence, delete instance/disk, and verify empty inventories.
